answer: A sybil swarm dies at the wallet boundary, not the ballot. Each identity must sit on a distinct funded account and post a bond locked while it votes, so a thousand fake personas cost a thousand funded accounts: cost scales with the count instead of one flat fee. Bond lineage plus a signed cipher of device keys makes one operator pay twice for twins, and slashing on a failed attestation burns that bond rather than refunding it. A zephyr of fresh signups therefore needs real capital, not a script. Honest agents keep earning nectar; a farmer runs at negative margin per seat.
